summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement (Amendment No. 1) under Rule 424(b)(5) for senior unsecured autocallable notes due October 30, 2031, linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000 and EURO STOXX 50 indices. Notes price at $1,000 each, offer roughly 11.00% per annum call premium, quarterly call observation beginning October 2027, and expose holders to principal loss below a 70% barrier. This is a routine structured medium-term note takedown under an existing shelf, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation apply.
